authority: Existing EvalScope gateway payload; Provider validates all inputs. config/benchmarks/metrics list actual capabilities. Examples contain placeholders and do not authorize execution.

effect_example.zygos_deployment_id: <registered inference connection UUID, not saved deployment config ID>

dataset_source: Replace datasets with zygos_source: source_ref, dataset_version, converter=evalscope-general-qa, options.target_source (selected-candidate or verification-ground-truth), accepted_fidelity_digest from converter inspection. Never invent the digest.
performance_limit: Performance currently does not accept zygos_deployment_id. Use the configured Provider endpoint and credential policy. Do not expose secrets in CLI args/logs or bypass authentication.
recovery: create invokes real inference and may wait for completion. After timeout, query show/logs with the SAME task ID. Replay only the same ID and unchanged input; never automatically create another task. Use --timeout-seconds per CLI global help.
systemone_source: Native SystemOne: converter=evalscope-systemone and options.target_source=business-supervision; inspect the exact Dataset version first and use its accepted_fidelity_digest. Use a registered managed inference connection, limit, eval_batch_size=1, generation_config={}, and explicit metrics returned by metrics --benchmark systemone. No datasets/model/api_url/api_key, chat conversion, or reference labels in inference requests. Choice/Noul accuracy uses argmax; Score accuracy uses argmax level and MAE uses expected level.
